description: Is a chat subscription (e.g. Claude Pro) cheaper than the same use through the API? Messages a day and tokens per message priced at the cheapest real-time seller of a model and at the maker's own API, a month of 30 days, against the subscription's price, with the break-even messages a day. USD. preset claude-pro / mistral-pro takes the plan price from our plan tables; otherwise pass price.

input_tokens.description: per message incl. the resent chat, default 3000

model.description: model id; default the preset's model (claude-pro: anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5)

preset.description: a plan we collect the price of

price.description: subscription USD a month, when no preset

name: subscription_vs_api
